prompt:
You run weekly onboarding A/B tests. Here is every finished test so far: what you predicted
and what was measured.

- round 1: Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +12.0%, measured +12.0% (p=0.0), won
- round 1: Live Desktop Pet Preview & Creation Studio [adoption, redesign]: predicted +8.0%, measured -4.1% (p=0.193793), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Desktop Visibility Diagnostic & Ready Alert [home, notification]: predicted +5.0%, measured -2.9% (p=0.247997), lost: no clear effect
- round 1: Animated Desktop Mascot App Intro [choose_path, copy]: predicted +3.0%, measured +0.2% (p=0.885584), lost: no clear effect
- round 2: Story-First Guided Onboarding Sequence [choose_path, reorder]: predicted +8.0%, measured +3.1% (p=0.032022), won
- round 2: Desktop Controls Interactive Guide [finish, redesign]: predicted -1.0%, measured -10.1% (p=0.002754), lost: worse
- round 2: Account Persistence Safety Notice [sign_in, copy]: predicted +3.0%, measured +3.5% (p=0.014209), won
- round 2: Interactive Trait Selector Waiting Screen [home, wait_info]: predicted +3.0%, measured +0.3% (p=0.88245), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Post-Adoption Account Registration Shift [sign_in, reorder]: predicted +12.0%, measured -8.9% (p=0.000149), stopped early: sign_in worse
- round 3: Custom Photo Quality Guidance Hint [adoption, hint]: predicted +0.5%, measured +1.8% (p=0.497113), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Completion Ready Desktop Audio Alert [home, notification]: predicted -2.9%, measured +0.4% (p=0.824731), lost: no clear effect
- round 3: Checklist Overview for Final Desktop Introduction [finish, layout]: predicted -5.0%, measured -5.6% (p=0.069168), lost: no clear effect
- round 4: Preset Pet Archetype Selection Gallery [adoption, redesign]: predicted -4.1%, measured -19.3% (p=0.000389), stopped early: adoption worse

- round 4: Desktop Pet Launch Button Copy [finish, copy]: predicted +0.5%, measured +6.7% (p=0.046322), won
- round 4: Asset Generation Progress & Time Indicator [home, wait_info]: predicted +0.3%, measured +3.6% (p=0.056664), lost: no clear effect

Previous lessons:
Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%), with positive impacts often overestimated.
Account safety copy changes during sign-in were helpful (+3.5%), whereas general intro copy updates showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and guides carry high risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1% vs -1.0%), while other redesigns showed no clear effect.
Notifications, waiting screens, hints, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect, making positive predictions (+0.5% to +5.0%) consistently too high.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Reordering onboarding flows can yield major wins (+12.0%, +3.1%), but can also severely backfire (-8.9%) or show no clear effect, with positive predictions often being too high.

Copy changes focused on account persistence safety (+3.5%) and launch call-to-actions (+6.7%) were helpful; launch button predictions were too low (+6.7% measured vs +0.5% predicted), while general intro copy showed no clear effect.
UI redesigns and interactive guides carry severe risk, hurting performance far worse than predicted (-10.1%, -19.3%), while others showed no clear effect.
Notifications, hints, waiting screens, and checklist layout changes showed no clear effect across all tested rounds.
